item.title: R Sorting Alphanumeric Strings Numerically How to Implement Mixed Sort
item.description:
“R Sorting Alphanumeric Strings Numerically How to Implement Mixed Sort”

When working with vectors in R that contain strings mixing letters and numbers (like “V51”, “V108”, “V116”), standard alphabetical sorting often produces incorrect results because it treats the string as text (“V108” comes before “V51”). How can we implement a mixed sort or natural sort in R to ensure the numeric portions dictate the final order?

We examine several effective methods for handling this common data manipulation task.
